references.text: Part of the same census of war plunder from the Midianites, which included small livestock, cattle, donkeys, and people.
Shows the distribution of the cattle, where 36,000 went to the congregation and 72 were given as a tribute to the Lord.
A similar law regarding war plunder allowing the Israelites to take livestock and everything else in the city as spoil.
Israel took livestock and plunder from Ai, in accordance with the rules for war plunder.
